title: Anti-inflammatory effect of high-abundance Core oligopeptides from white tea via the PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Lao, Zhizhan; Lin, Xiaoqing; Ye, Xiuqin; Ke, Weihao; Wu, Cong; You, Xuelian; Wang, Xiaojuan; Zhao, Feng
one_liner_zh: 研究白茶寡肽通过PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB通路发挥抗炎作用，对象为肽-蛋白信号通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: White tea exhibits remarkable anti-inflammatory activity. Its unique prolonged withering process promotes protein hydrolysis, enriching oligopeptides whose bioactivity is governed by specific constituent amino acid sequences. However, the core anti-inflammatory sequences and their mechanisms remain unclear. To address this, an integrated multi-omics and experimental strategy was employed. Forty-eight high-abundance oligopeptides were identified, with network pharmacology revealing their interaction with key inflammatory targets via the PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB pathway. Four core candidates-LCAY, SGFGG, SGGFG, and HHMCC-were selected based on binding affinity. Validations in LPS-induced RAW264.7 cells confirmed these peptides significantly suppressed NO, IL-1beta, and TNF-alpha. Furthermore, Western blot analysis demonstrated that these oligopeptides exert anti-inflammatory effects by inhibiting the phosphorylation of PI3K, AKT, and IKK, and blocked the nuclear translocation of NF-kappaB. These findings elucidate the material basis of white tea's anti-inflammatory properties and highlight the therapeutic potential of its bioactive oligopeptides.
abstract_zh: 白茶展现出显著的抗炎活性。其独特的长时间萎凋过程促进蛋白质水解，富集了寡肽，其生物活性由特定的组成氨基酸序列决定。然而，核心抗炎序列及其机制仍不明确。为解决此问题，采用了整合多组学和实验策略。鉴定出48种高丰度寡肽，网络药理学揭示它们通过PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB通路与关键炎症靶点相互作用。基于结合亲和力，筛选出四个核心候选肽——LCAY、SGFGG、SGGFG和HHMCC。在LPS诱导的RAW264.7细胞中的验证实验确认，这些肽显著抑制NO、IL-1beta和TNF-alpha。此外，Western blot分析表明，这些寡肽通过抑制PI3K、AKT和IKK的磷酸化，并阻断NF-kappaB的核转位，发挥抗炎作用。这些发现阐明了白茶抗炎特性的物质基础，并突显了其生物活性寡肽的治疗潜力。
